reply.emotion: satisfied and relieved, checking the bank account on payday
notes: Sueldo refers to regular fixed pay, usually monthly or biweekly. It is very close to 'salario', though 'sueldo' often implies a stable, professional job.

senses.definition: Cantidad de dinero regular que recibe una persona por su trabajo.

examples.text: Con mi nuevo sueldo puedo pagar el alquiler.
examples.translation: With my new salary I can pay the rent.
examples.emotion: relieved and hopeful, feeling things are looking up

definitions: Cantidad de dinero regular que recibe una persona por su trabajo.
